The three market-row NPCs (Krshia/Peddler/Watch Sergeant) each carry their own directional sprite (pc_gnoll_f/pc_human_m/pc_drake_m respectively) matching their own copy's canon/pronouns, no shared tint-differentiated sprite between them. entities.observe: Watch armor, kept. He stands the post properly: weight even, eyes on the gap in the wall. Bored, but the boredom is a discipline, not a lapse.
entities.friendly_line: The guard's mouth twitches toward a smile despite himself. Hah. You seem decent enough. Go on through easy - I'll remember the friendly one.
talk_pool: Gate's clear. Keep it that way and we'll get on fine.
Move along or stand aside. The post is not a meeting spot.
Watch business is Watch business. Yours is likely somewhere else.
Long shift, nothing's happened. That's the shift going well - for the record.

dialogue.speaker: Watch Guard
dialogue.text: Keep the gate clear. And if you're headed out, the road's got goblins on it lately. Watch knows. Watch is dealing with it.

entities._comment: Zevara Sunderscale, Drake Watch Captain, just inside the gate below the guard. Cell (2,6) sits BELOW the three gate corridors every street-route walks -- y3 (entry/forecourt), y4 (transit lane), and crate_light's y5 PHASE-D return (left-28 to (2,5)) -- verified against the passing event logs of gate_district_walkthrough/crate_talk/crate_fight/social_loop and crate_light's intended path; she blocks no walked cell. NPCs are NOT in the sim blocked set (WIGame builds blocked_cells from static `blocked`+wall segments only), so she does NOT shift gate_district_walkthrough's blocked_cells:106 assert. sprite `zevara` is a PixelLab pixflux gen (armored light-blue Drake Watch officer) -- see sprites.json + VISUAL-LOG.
entities.observe: Oldblood Drake, light scales, a scar down the left of her jaw she's long past explaining. She reads the gate the way a clerk reads a ledger: every figure accounted for, and every one of them a suspect.
entities.friendly_line: Zevara's shoulders come down a fraction. Huh. Civil, and no bribe. You would not believe how short that list is. Go on through. And, thank you. Genuinely.
talk_pool: If you're here to report a crime, the form's on the left. If you're here to commit one, don't. I've had a day.
Ten years running this Watch. Six weeks of leave, total. That's the whole personality, if you were wondering.
Relc's off being enormous at someone. Klbkch is... Klbkch. The gate still stands. Don't jinx it.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/zevara_stages.json (staging_note/_flag annotations stripped). Two stages -- she does not do three degrees of warmth on duty. Perk (watch-bounty access) is the dialogue_unlocks wired into zevara_intro.json's hub + new claimed_bounty_{crate,cisterns,warren} counters, each banked on the CLAIM option (effects live on options, never nodes).

lines: You. Good. Stand there and look like a competent citizen where the recruits can see you. That's an order I can't officially give.
The cistern file is closed. Do you know how few files CLOSE in this office? I keep it on top of the stack for morale.
If you're between jobs, see me about bounty work. The Watch pays slow, but it pays. And I sign faster for people who don't invoice me for heroics.

dialogue.speaker: Zevara
dialogue.text: The gate's my problem, so keep it dull and we'll get along fine.

entities._comment: Issue #51: Klbkch the Slayer -- Antinium Senior Guardsman, Relc's patrol partner (wiki-verified profile in docs/design/character-profiles.md; our-era 4-arm form, twin swords). Stationed at the gate plaza beside Zevara, at (4,6): OFF both the y4 transit lane and the y5 corridor ((3,5) blocked the mage_unlock/lantern/crate_light left-walk to (2,5) -- corner-pick lesson: grep DESTINATION cells and the lanes crossing them): the Watch's public face is exactly where the city's one visible Antinium belongs. Voice contract: precise, courteous, unfailingly calm, dry understatement -- NEVER jokey. Stage line keys on the same resolved_the_cisterns counter Zevara's trusted-irregular stage uses (one Watch ledger, two readers of it). PLACEMENT TRAP: street NPC cells must be grepped against every script's DESTINATION cells AND the walk-lanes crossing them (y4 transit, y5 corridor) -- (3,5) broke three canonicals' left-walk.
entities.observe: An Antinium of Liscor's Watch — dark chitin, four arms, antennae, twin swords worn at the hips like a closed argument. He stands still the way patient things do.
talk_pool: Guardsman Klbkch, Liscor Watch. If you have business, state it plainly. If you have none, the plaza is pleasant and I am content to stand here with you.
You are staring. That is common. Take whatever time you require; I am on duty until nightfall regardless.
Relc is my partner. He is loud, occasionally literal, and the finest spear in the city. I file our reports. The arrangement suits us both.
The city grows. More carts, more disputes, more forms. I have four hands and still the paperwork accumulates. There is a lesson in that, though I decline to learn it.

lines: The cistern matter reached the Watch ledger with your name beside it. I remember names. It is most of my job.
Zevara speaks well of you, which she does for almost no one. I mention it because she will not.

entities._comment: Olesm Swifttail, Drake [Tactician]/council clerk, at the Guild frontage. Cell (29,3) is tucked by the Guild building, clear of gate_district_walkthrough's forecourt cells (25,4)/(25,5)/(26,5)/(27,5)/(27,4)/(27,3) and of crate_light's y5 pisces approach -- verified off every street-route path, and NPCs are excluded from the blocked_cells count. sprite `olesm` is a PixelLab pixflux gen (slim sky-blue Drake holding a rolled map) -- see sprites.json + VISUAL-LOG.
entities.observe: Thin, sky-blue scales, ink drying on three of his claws. A chess board waits at his elbow mid-game, played against himself, to feel how the other side thinks. His eyes are a wild, patterned blue, the one soft thing about a man who counts exits.
entities.friendly_line: Olesm brightens like a lamp. Oh! A friendly face. Most people's eyes glaze when I mention troop dispersal. Yours didn't. Would you... that is... care to see the board sometime? No pressure. A little pressure.
talk_pool: Three reports due by dawn and the ink is winning. If anyone asks, the [Tactician] of Liscor is 'strategizing'.
Three reports due by dusk and two clerks who can't count past a company. I'll manage. I always manage.
Supply lines, sightlines, morale: a city is only a very slow battle, and Liscor has been winning it for centuries. I intend to keep the streak.
Selys works the desk inside now, board and all. I still find reasons to linger out here more than the job requires. The paperwork doesn't ask why.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/olesm_stages.json (staging_note/_flag annotations stripped). The chess-beat perk (stage 3, olesm_board_partner) shipped option+frame only for one wave; issue #25 built the real match (olesm_intro.json's olesm_chess_invite chain) and added the THIRD stage below as its residue -- once chess_with_olesm banks, the one-time hub option retires (hide_when) and this shorter rematch pool takes over. New key only (chess_with_olesm), so the ascending-threshold validator has nothing to compare it against on the shared keys.

lines: Oh — you! No no, the tally can wait. The tally is wrong anyway; it will still be wrong in an hour.
I put your cistern business in my report. With your name spelled correctly and everything. In this office that is practically a parade.
I've started leaving the second chair out. Statistically you keep existing near my desk, so — efficiency.
I set the board up when the bells go quiet now, on the chance you wander past. That isn't pathetic, that's PREPARED.
Erin beat me in eleven moves yesterday. Eleven! I wrote them all down. I'm going to frame the humiliation and study it daily.
You, me, the board, one hour. I've been saving an opening that is either brilliant or a resignation with extra steps.
Rematch, someday. Not today; I need my dignity back first.
I still replay our game some nights. I win in my head. It isn't the same.

dialogue.speaker: Olesm
dialogue.text: One moment; three columns into a tally. Say hello properly and I'll lose my place gladly.

entities.toast: Warm bread smell over the whole row. No one's minding the stall this exact moment. The loaves aren't going anywhere without a fight.

Silverfang goods laid out with a trap's care: cheapest at the front, the good stock where a browsing hand drifts. A note warns that the seller remembers faces.
entities.toast: Silverfang goods, honest prices. The Gnoll shopkeeper is off haggling elsewhere. A sign says she remembers faces, and debts.

Pisces Jealnv (Human [Necromancer], canon -- Horns of Hammerad). Guild frontage (30,4), east of guild_door (28,3), clear of gate_district_walkthrough's forecourt approach cells (27,3/27,4/27,5/26,5/25,5). Bespoke PixelLab sprite (hooded young human in immaculate white robes with faded trim + sash), replacing the earlier citizen_f cool-white-tint stand-in. Teaches magic via the pisces_magic graph; mage.gained_by keys to its learned_magic_from_pisces bank.
entities.observe: Thin, immaculate, hungry in a way food will not fix. He holds himself like a duelist and watches hands, not faces. Whatever he studies, it is not small.
entities.friendly_line: A sniff - though a fractionally warmer one. You are... tolerable company. Rarer praise than you comprehend. I shall permit you to remain within conversational range.
talk_pool: You linger. Either you have a question of substance or you are another gawker. I shall assume the former. Generously.
Magic is not the wand-waving the market storytellers sell. It is discipline. Precision. Neither, I observe, is common here.
Yes, a [Necromancer]. No, I will not apologize for a competence others lack the wit to appreciate.
Do continue standing there. I find the silence rather more edifying than most conversation.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/pisces_stages.json (staging_note/_flag annotations stripped). Two stages -- he only ever thaws to 'tolerable'. NO spec-default perk (the staging doc explicitly says build nothing -- the duelist's-drill/gift proposal ships as an open flag, not code) -- only the stage row + the hard-railed hub topic unlock ship.

lines: Ah. You. Acceptable timing. I was on the verge of being bored, and you are marginally better than boredom. I do not say that to many.
Your channel has stopped embarrassing you, I trust. Good. I dislike wasted instruction; it reflects on the instructor.
The bread stall raises its prices after the fourth bell. Buy before. There — advice worth coin, given freely. Note the date.

talk_pool_stages._comment: Pisces studies at the inn over N sleeps -- opaque-until-sleep: his talk-pool stages shift, zero progress text. TWO stages, gated on the hidden `door_study_sleeps` counter (wi_game.gd's sleep()-beat hook, banked once the ruin-recovery chain's beat-3 counters are held) -- the talk_pool_stages idiom itself (social.gd walks the array in AUTHORED order, last-met-wins), appended AFTER pisces_tolerable_company so an active study period reads as the more current topic even for a player who already reached 'tolerable company'. Zero numbers, zero fractions -- opacity holds.
lines: I have had that stone of yours on my desk every night since. It resists categorization. Aggravating. I approve.
Closer. Whatever your door remembers being, it has stopped fighting me about it.

talk_pool_stages._comment: Issue #89 (gap-2, second-door mini-arc): the field-trip payoff. Gated on the HIDDEN `second_door_study_sleeps` counter (wi_game.gd's own sleep()-beat mirror of door_study_sleeps, guarded on door_awakened already banked) -- same opacity contract, zero numbers. Unlike the first door's stone (brought to his desk), the second door can't be moved -- Pisces goes to IT instead, hence 'field trip'. Appended AFTER pisces_door_study_2 (later match wins) so an active second-door study period reads as the more current topic.
lines: I made the walk down to your second door last night. Grim commute. Worth it — the wardwork answers exactly like the first, which tells me nothing new and confirms everything I suspected.
I have marked the safest line down to it, start to finish. You will not need to re-walk that gauntlet blind again — I made certain of that much, if only so I never have to.

dialogue.speaker: Pisces
dialogue.text: Yes, I am a [Necromancer]. No, I did not raise anything in this square. Move along, or ask me something worth my time.

entities.observe: Rust holds the bars, not a lock. The draft is steady — a tunnel, not a pit. The skittering keeps its distance. Something down there has learned to avoid shadows.
entities.toast: A heavy iron grate, rusted shut. Cold air rises from below, and something in the dark skitters away from your shadow.
entities._comment_door_when: The grate-gate seam. Until `heard_about_cisterns` is banked (from Olesm), door_when's gate is UNMET and interact falls through to the on_interact_accomplishment branch above -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-quest behavior asserted by gate_district_walkthrough (heard_the_sewers + the exact toast). Once banked, the same interact hauls the grate open and descends: emits the `open_toast`, then transitions to the sewers landing. See wi_game.gd interact()'s prop branch + `_door_gate_met`.

door_when.open_toast: You set your shoulder to the grate. The rust gives with a shriek, and cold air breathes up out of the dark. Down you go.

entities._comment: Sprite is `pc_gnoll_f` (a real directional Gnoll sprite, matching this entity's own copy -- 'A Gnoll with a merchant's smile', canon 'Hrr.' speech tic); no tint. De-twinned from the Peddler, who no longer shares this sprite.
entities.observe: A Gnoll with a merchant's smile and a soldier's eyes. She prices you the moment you approach, and remembers the number.
entities.friendly_line: You have a warm way about you, and warmth I can trade with. Come - for you, I will call it a fair price, and I will mean it. This is not nothing, from me.
talk_pool: You look, you do not buy. This is fine. Looking is its own kind of respect.
Silverfang goods - fair weight, fair price. I do not haggle down, and I do not forget a face.
You carry yourself better than before. Good. A city notices such things, even when its people pretend not to.
Speak plainly with me and we get along well. The other kind of talk, I have no patience for.
entities._comment_stages: Lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/krshia_stages.json (staging_note/_flag annotations stripped). Three stages -- crate_returned accrues TODAY (pool shipped), so stage 2 goes live the moment the seam lands. Stage 3's shop-discount perk is wired into krshia_crate.json's 'shop' node (4 stage-gated duplicate buy options + hide_when-retired full-price rows); the necklace-reveal hub topic (krshia_plans) is the OBLIQUE canon version -- never says 'spellbook' (user gate, see HANDOFF).

lines: The crate-finder. Sit, look, touch even. You have earned handling privileges.
You did a thing for me and did not name a price after. I remember this the way I remember debts. Better, even.
The stall does well today. When the stall does well, the tribe does well. That is all the economics you need.
Good — you. Come stand by the stall; you make the other customers braver. They think if you have not been bitten yet, they will not be.
I sold honey-bread this morning and thought, that one would like this. So. There is a piece behind the counter. Do not tell the Watch I do favorites.
You listen the way Gnolls listen. Whole ears. It is rarer in this city than good wool, and wool does not walk up to my stall twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: Krshia
dialogue.text: Busy, yes? Come back when you can talk.
